comment: Reviewed type duplicates kept separate. Use name for a same-name cluster, pairKey for an exact report pair, or memberKey for a literal-set cluster. Every entry requires a reason.

entries.name: ScheduledTask
entries.reason: Frozen contract-type copies mandated by the LifeOps/health architecture rule: plugin-health and plugin-personal-assistant contribute ScheduledTask via local contract-types and must NOT import plugin-scheduling internals. Consolidating would violate that boundary. #10201.

entries.name: AgentListItemDto
entries.reason: Cloud API DTO shapes are maintained in packages/cloud/shared, packages/cloud/sdk, and packages/ui. Consolidation requires a shared generation or dependency contract, not a manual merge. #10201.
